question: For the female client who was born in 1976/1/29, which district did she opened her account?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T4.A2
FROM Client_Info AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = '1976-01-29'
